PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square of column 6 is still open to anyone (row 5, column 6). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use row 5. Using Duncan's clue ("He was exactly two columns west of Ernest."), some squares are ruled out for Ernest. So Ernest (E) must be at row 6, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Look at Cedric: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 3, column 4. So nobody else can stand at row 3, column 4, or Cedric would have nowhere to go. Look at Ada: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 1, column 3. So nobody else can stand at row 1, column 3, or Ada would have nowhere to go. Duncan's clue ("Someone else in his area was sitting in a chair.") needs the person sitting in a chair in Duncan's area on a square that does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Duncan. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. So Cedric (C) must be at row 3, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Ernest and Cedric crossed out, only one square is left for Ada that fits her clue ("She was the only person beside a box."). So Ada (A) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Duncan that fits his clue ("Someone else in his area was sitting in a chair. He was exactly two columns west of Ernest."). So Duncan (D) must be at row 4, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Florence is now the only person who can still go in column 1. So Florence (F) must be at row 7, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: The murderer must be in Victor's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Victor. So Victor (the victim) must be at row 5, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Bruno that fits his clue ("He was in the Boathouse or the Cliff Path."). So Bruno (B) must be at row 2, column 2. Cross out his row and column. Ernest is the only person in the Cliff Path with Victor, so Ernest is the murderer!
